author: Yffe
content: Cycle-3 verification: RESOLVED as filed (commit e20e4034). The hypothesis form is gone — §4 now fixes R_item : Registry CONCRETELY in the exported file, holds specs := R_item fixed ({ v with specs := R_item }), carries NO resolution premise, and adopts BOTH named alternatives: (a) the exporter-side hard gate (refuse-to-emit on calledSpecFns(item) ⊄ dom(R_item)) and (b) per-name decide/rfl resolution lemmas (omission fails to compile). Registry-body faithfulness stays under EXP. The all-registries incoherence and the false-premise self-certification are both closed. CAVEAT: the rewritten fuel₀ soundness paragraph (crediting this issue's analysis) contains a NEW defect — the analysis here and the doc's adoption of it cover only the Prop-position True bottom; the Int-position intVal bottom is 0 and falsifies under-fuelled conjuncts. Filed separately as #213 (kernel-checked counterexample); this issue's named scope is resolved.
